en.intro: Victor hadn't an enemy in the world. Or so he thought.
aanwijzingen: A · Annie (♀ woman · hat): Was in the 6th column.
B · Bridget (♀ woman · hat): Was the only person in the cloakroom. Was in the bottom half.
C · Charles (♂ man · glasses): Was in the 4th row. Was in the rightmost column of the room.
D · Dylan (♂ man · glasses): Was in a column further right than Annie.
E · Emily (♀ woman): Someone else in their room wore a hat.
F · Freddie (♂ man · hat): Was alone in the café. Was in the top row of the room.
V · Victor (♂ man): the victim. The murderer is the only suspect in the same room.
en.regels: one person per row and per column · "next to" = directly above/below/left/right, in the same room · nobody can be on blocked objects (⊘) · the victim has no clue · attributes (♂ man, ♀ woman, glasses, hat) follow each name; when counting "in total", the person themselves and the victim are included.
en.dader: The murderer is Charles (C). The victim, Victor, lay in the Egyptian room.

Emily is on [2,5], so row 2 and column 5 are ruled out for Victor. → Victor at [7,1]

de.intro: Viktor hatte keine Feinde. Dachte er.

B · Britta (♀ Frau · Hut): War die einzige Person in der Garderobe. War in der unteren Hälfte.

de.dader: Die Tat beging Carsten (C). Das Opfer, Viktor, lag im Ägyptischen Saal.

C · Cédric (♂ homme · lunettes): Était dans la 4e rangée. Se trouvait dans la colonne la plus à droite de sa pièce.
D · Damien (♂ homme · lunettes): Était dans une colonne plus à droite que celle d'Adèle.
E · Élise (♀ femme): Quelqu'un d'autre dans sa pièce portait un chapeau.

it.intro: Vittorio non aveva nemici. O almeno così credeva.

B · Bruna (♀ donna · cappello): Era l'unica persona nel guardaroba. Era nella metà inferiore.
C · Claudio (♂ uomo · occhiali): Era nella 4ª riga. Si trovava nella colonna più a destra della stanza.
D · Dario (♂ uomo · occhiali): Si trovava in una colonna più a destra di Adele.
E · Elena (♀ donna): Qualcun altro nella sua stanza portava un cappello.
F · Francesco (♂ uomo · cappello): Era da solo in caffetteria. Si trovava nella riga più in alto della stanza.
V · Vittorio (♂ uomo): la vittima. Il colpevole è l'unico sospettato nella stessa stanza.

it.dader: Il colpevole è Claudio (C). La vittima, Vittorio, giaceva nella sala egizia.

pl.intro: Viktor nie miał wrogów. Tak mu się przynajmniej wydawało.

C · Cyprian (♂ mężczyzna · okulary): Znajdował się w 4. rzędzie. Był w skrajnej prawej kolumnie swojego pomieszczenia.
